title: Procurement Executive – CGD Materials
description:
**About PipedGas (an Enamun business)** PipedGas (pipedgas.in) is an online procurement and planning platform run by Enamun Pvt. Ltd.,built for City Gas Distribution (CGD) contractors working on PNG, MDPE and GC projects. Contractors describe their work requirement, the platform turns it into a checked bill of quantities (BOQ), and Enamun returns a priced quotation, typically within one working day. We supply materials for domestic PNG connections (LMC and conversion), MDPE network installation and gas station maintenance: MDPE pipes and PE fittings, GI pipes and fittings, copper tube and fittings, brass and MLC fittings, valves and regulators, meter adaptors and disconnectors, clamps and fasteners, consumables, tools and machines, and safety/PPE. Material is delivered across India from Enamun's own regional stores at Gurugram, Bhubaneswar and Sangli, with Ambikapur, Sambhajinagar, Sehore and Erode coming soon. **Role Summary** The Procurement Executive is the supply side of the PipedGas platform. Every contractor enquiry that Sales quotes depends on the right material, from a make approved by that CGD operator, at a competitive buy price, available in the right store. You will source and develop manufacturers, keep approved make and pricing data current, back Sales with fast vendor quotes, keep the regional stores stocked, and make sure every dispatch carries the required QAP, MTC or inspection report.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sourcing of CGD materials** •Source the full PipedGas catalogue: MDPE pipes and PE (electrofusion / spigot) fittings, GI pipes and GI fittings, copper tube (Cu-DHP to BS EN 1057) and copper fittings, brass and MLC fittings, GI appliance and isolation valves, regulators, brass meter adaptors and disconnectors, clamps, supports, fasteners, consumables and markers. •Source tools and machines used by CGD crews (spanners, wrenches, pliers, NPT dies, electrofusion and pipe-cutting equipment) and safety / PPE items. •Source pressure regulation and metering items for gas station work as the range expands. •Replace "make to be confirmed" lines in the catalogue with firm, approved makes and current buy prices.

**2. Approved makes and CGD operator compliance**

•Build and maintain the approved-make matrix for each CGD operator and geographical area we serve; track changes to operators' approved vendor lists and update the catalogue accordingly. •Get vendors registered / approved with CGD operators where needed, and keep their documents (BIS licences, type-test reports, ISO certificates, QAPs) on file. •Ensure compliance with PNGRB technical standards (T4S) and applicable BIS / international standards for each item.

**3. Quotation support to Sales** •Get vendor prices, lead times and stock for enquiry lines quickly so Sales can meet the one-working-day quotation target. •Flag lines that are unavailable or need more detail (size, make, rating) so Sales can mark them in the revised list. •Maintain a live rate database and price trends for high-volume items (MDPE pipe, PE fittings, GI, copper, brass). **4. Vendor development and Enamun-brand items** •Identify, evaluate and empanel manufacturers and distributors across key CGD markets; develop at least two sources for critical items. •Develop and manage contract manufacturers for Enamun-brand products: specifications, samples, QAP, pricing and capacity. •Run vendor performance reviews on quality, delivery, price and documentation. **5. Purchasing and commercial** •Float RFQs, prepare comparative statements, negotiate and issue POs; finalise rate contracts for fast-moving items. •Manage payment terms, GST, freight and landed cost; reconcile invoices with Accounts. •Place back-to-back purchases against confirmed customer orders and buy for stock against approved plans.

**6. MIS and cost optimization** •Maintain procurement MIS: spend, savings, price trends, vendor performance, open POs and stock cover by store. •Reduce costs through volume consolidation, rate contracts, alternate sources and Enamun-brand substitution.

**Candidate Requirements Education** •B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering preferred; any graduate with strong relevant experience will be considered. •MBA / PGDM in Materials or Supply Chain Management is a plus.

**Experience** •

3–6 years of purchase / procurement experience with a CGD company, a CGD EPC / LMC contractor, or a supplier of CGD materials.

•Hands-on buying of MDPE pipe, PE fittings, GI, copper and brass fittings, regulators and valves for PNG and steel/MDPE network work.

•Practical knowledge of approved-make lists and vendor approval processes at major CGD operators.

**Knowledge and skills** •Working knowledge of PNGRB T4S and the product standards for these items (e.g. IS 14885 for PE gas pipes, IS 1239 for GI pipes, BS EN 1057 for copper tube). •Strong existing network of CGD material manufacturers and distributors, ideally across North, East and West India. •Comfortable reading BOQs, drawings and item specifications; able to spot wrong size, rating or make. •Strong negotiation, costing and GST knowledge; ERP / Zoho proficiency and advanced Excel. •Responsive and organized: able to turn around vendor quotes the same day. English and Hindi; one more regional language is a plus.

**Good to have**

•Experience in B2B e-commerce, distribution or a trading company serving contractors.

•Exposure to private label / contract manufacturing and to gas station (DRS / metering skid) items.

**Key Performance Indicators** •Turnaround time on vendor quotes for Sales enquiries •Share of enquiry lines quotable with an approved make •Buy-price savings versus last purchase price / market •Vendor on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery and stock-outs per store •Rejection / return rate and documentation completeness (MTC, QAP, inspection report) •New approved vendors and Enamun-brand items added per quarter

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in CGD company, a CGD EPC / LMC contractor Company?
* What is your Notice period ?
* Are you willing to travel or shift to Gurgaon, Sec 43?
* What is your current salary?
* What is your expected salary?

Work Location: In person
